en.codex: A tragic tale of woe and misery, and at last I am cast in it!
en.codex_needsfuel: The tale falls silent. It hungers for the fuel of darkness!
en.no_max_sanity: Hold! My mind can bear no more shades than these.
en.shadow_mine: Mine understudy! A fine likeness, but she shan't steal my role.
en.shadow_other: Thou wear'st some ally's likeness, shade. Fight with honor!

pt.codex: Um conto trágico de infortúnio e desgraça, e enfim ganhei um papel!
pt.codex_needsfuel: O conto se calou. Anseia pelo combustível da escuridão!
pt.no_max_sanity: Basta! Minha mente não suporta mais sombras além destas.
pt.shadow_mine: Minha substituta! Muito parecida comigo, mas não vai roubar meu papel!
pt.shadow_other: Tens a feição de algum aliado, sombra. Luta com honra!

zh.codex: 充满悲哀和痛苦的悲剧故事，终于有我的戏份了！
zh.codex_needsfuel: 故事戛然而止。它渴求暗黑燃料！
zh.no_max_sanity: 且慢！我的心神再也容不下更多暗影了。
zh.shadow_mine: 我的替身演员！长得真像我，但休想抢我的角色。
zh.shadow_other: 暗影啊，汝披着某位盟友的模样。为荣誉而战吧！

ru.codex: Трагичная повесть, полная горя и мучений! Наконец-то и мне досталась роль!
ru.codex_needsfuel: Повесть умолкла. Она жаждет топлива тьмы!
ru.no_max_sanity: Довольно! Больше теней мой рассудок не вынесет.
ru.shadow_mine: Моя дублерша! Похожа как две капли воды, но роли моей ей не видать!
ru.shadow_other: Облик кого-то из союзников носишь ты, тень. Бейся с честью!

pt.codex: A tragic tale of misfortune and disgrace, and at last I got a role!
pt.codex_needsfuel: The tale has gone quiet. It longs for the fuel of darkness!
pt.no_max_sanity: Enough! My mind cannot bear more shadows beyond these.
pt.shadow_mine: My understudy! Very much like me, but she won't steal my role!
pt.shadow_other: Thou hast the features of some ally, shadow. Fight (thou) with honor!

zh.codex: A tragic story full of sorrow and pain, and finally I have a part in it!
zh.codex_needsfuel: The story stops abruptly. It craves dark fuel!
zh.no_max_sanity: Wait! My mind cannot hold any more shadows.
zh.shadow_mine: My stand-in actor! Looks just like me, but don't even think of stealing my role.
zh.shadow_other: O shadow, thou wearest the likeness of some ally. Fight for honor!

ru.codex: A tragic tale full of grief and torment! At last I too have been given a role!
ru.codex_needsfuel: The tale has fallen silent. It thirsts for the fuel of darkness!
ru.no_max_sanity: Enough! More shadows my reason will not endure.
ru.shadow_mine: My understudy! Alike as two drops of water, but my role she'll never see!
ru.shadow_other: The likeness of one of the allies wear thou, shadow. Fight with honor!

voice_notes: Wigfrid is an actress who has vanished into the role of a valkyrie. She speaks in mock-archaic English ('tis, hath, thou, mine), invokes Odin, Loki, Hel and Valhalla, and thinks in terms of foes, allies, glory and meat. Now and then the actress shows through ('I have my own costu- that is, warrior's garb!', 'This play is in need of actors.'). She already reads the Codex as a drama ('A tragic tale of woe and misery!') and calls nightmare fuel 'The fuel of darkness!'. PT-BR keeps her feminine and gives her archaic tu forms in commands ('Revela-te, demônio!', 'Retornaste!'). It calls the fuel 'O combustível da escuridão!'. ZH writes plain, vivid exclamations and switches to 汝/吾 for high drama ('看吾斩断汝暗影干涉的爪子！'). It renders the fuel as '暗黑燃料！'. RU uses bardic inverted word order ('Огни Вальхаллы вижу я?', 'Вернулся ты!'), feminine verb forms and 'Топливо тьмы!'.

line_notes.codex: It extends her vanilla line, and 'cast' works both as a stage role and as a spell, so the actress finally gets her part in the tragedy.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: She treats the empty book as a saga that has stopped mid-scene and reuses her own name for nightmare fuel, so the need for fuel is unmistakable.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: A curt battlefield 'Hold!' and a plain admission that her mind can carry no more shades than the ones already out make it read clearly as 'can't summon more right now'.
line_notes.shadow_mine: A shadow copy of the actress is her understudy, and her vanity about the role is the joke. It echoes her 'There can be only one!' attitude toward other Wigfrids.
line_notes.shadow_other: She addresses the shade directly in her archaic warrior register. She sees that it wears an ally's face without knowing whose, and she hails it as a comrade in arms.
